purpose: Factual official NetLogo Web numeric-color binding observations for a later independently authored UI projection; not copied engine implementation

observedRuntimeBindings.numericWrap: Remainder modulo140; add140 when remainder is negative.
observedRuntimeBindings.numericLookup: Index the 1400-entry RGB table by Math.floor(10*wrappedColor). This was read directly from the loaded module's colorToRGB function, not guessed from samples.
observedRuntimeBindings.scaleColor: Loaded scaleColor computes a shade offset in0..9.9999 and adds10 times the wrapped base color's ten-unit group. Exact numeric boundaries were also queried in the separate source-model report.
observedRuntimeBindings.lookupExtraction: Read loaded module colorToRGB((i + 0.25) / 10) for every integer i from0 through1399. The quarter-bin offset avoids decimal boundary rounding; entry i is the factual cached RGB for that tenth-color bin.
observedRuntimeBindings.interpolationAndCacheConstruction: Not inferred. Cache-construction coefficients/rounding were not exposed by the inspected exported functions. The table below records observed runtime values; no engine implementation code is copied.

lookup.serializedHashConvention: SHA256 over UTF-8 JSON.stringify(rgb1400), no spaces or newline

limits: Read-only primitive calls and Command Center show output only; no target implementation or independent review.
The model XML is pinned; the loaded engine's complete bundle was not separately downloaded/hashed. The relevant exported function bodies were fingerprinted, not copied.
Numeric RGB mapping is discrete by tenth-color lookup; interpolation between observed bins is not asserted.
Model license attribution is retained in source archives; these RGB facts do not copy/transpile the NetLogo engine.
